sources.title: dseditor/minimax-h3-studio-assets · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 Studio assets (mirror) Everything the H3 Studio web frontend needs on top of the base MiniMax H3 models, collected in one place so a Colab notebook can fetch it with a single hf_hub_download loop. The folder layout mirrors ComfyUI/models/, so each file goes to the same relative path.
